prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reframe this exact realistic red tulip image for a square children's picture card. Keep the same red cup-shaped tulip, realistic petal texture, colors, two green leaves, lighting and warm ivory background. Zoom out so the COMPLETE flower sprig, including a clearly visible neat cut end of the green stem, fits entirely inside the canvas. Shorten only the bare lower stem as needed. Leave at least 10 percent empty ivory margin above the bloom AND below the stem tip. Keep the complete leaves inside frame. The entire specimen should occupy at most 80 percent of canvas height. original_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE square realistic flower portrait for a children's Bengali-English picture dictionary. Subject: one fresh red tulip, a recognizable classic single cup-shaped tulip bloom with six naturally overlapping smooth red petals, slightly open at the top, on one upright gently curved green stem with two long broad lance-shaped blue-green leaves attached naturally to the stem. Botanical photographic realism, delicate petal veins and fine natural texture, soft satin petals with subtle red shading and slight organic irregularities. Elegant complete flower specimen, the flower head large enough to read clearly at mobile thumbnail size; full bloom, stem and both leaves entirely visible with comfortable clear margins. Plain warm ivory seamless background, soft diffuse daylight, gentle subtle shadows. Natural proportions and restrained rich red, no plastic sheen, cartoon styling, giant eyes, extra flowers, vase, pot, soil, hands, scenery, labels, text, border or watermark. Match a clean premium natural-history picture card.
